title: Web Designer
html:
Here at Ailytics, we're building AI solutions to envision a safer world. By combining computer vision and predictive analytics, we enable organizations to proactively identify risks, optimize processes, and ultimately save lives. Our platforms are currently deployed all over the world, covering more than 500 million square meters!

We are looking for a web designer who designs a site and ships it, using AI as a core part of how they work.

This isn't a hand-off role. You'll prototype with tools like Lovable, v0 and Claude Design, then build production code with Claude Code or similar agents, owning the work from concept to a live, fast, maintainable site.

What You Will Be Doing

Design

  • Design our website, landing pages and microsites, from information architecture to final visuals.
  • Turn complex AI and computer vision concepts into clear visual stories for customers and investors.
  • Build and maintain a lightweight design system, using AI to explore directions fast and craft to refine them.

Build

  • Ship your designs as responsive, accessible, production-ready code.
  • Drive AI coding agents to build and debug, and review what they produce.
  • Own performance, SEO, analytics, cross-browser quality, deployment and CMS setup.

Collaborate

  • Work with leadership, sales and product on page goals, messaging and success metrics.
  • Iterate on live pages using analytics, feedback and A/B tests.
  • Share AI workflows and prompts that make the wider team faster.

Our Ideal Requirements

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in web design, front-end or a hybrid role.
  • A daily AI workflow you can show: prototyping (Lovable, v0, Claude Design), AI-assisted coding (Claude Code, Cursor), and strong prompting.
  • Solid HTML, CSS and JS/TS, plus a modern framework (Next.js/React, Astro, Vue or SvelteKit); you can read and fix generated code by hand.
  • Tailwind or similar, responsive design, accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and Core Web Vitals.
  • Git and deployment to Vercel, Netlify or similar.
  • A strong visual eye and the ability to work independently.
  • Experience designing for B2B SaaS, AI or deep-tech products is a plus.

Why Work At Ailytics?

  • This is an opportunity to create lasting impact and explore the intersection of AI and safety.
  • We're a start-up that's still in its early stages. If you're looking for an environment where you can really make an impact, this is it.
  • We value strong standards, high transparency, and low egos. Let us know if this sounds like you.
